```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "tableone"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
data_complete <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("Age", "sex", "Rx", "crp", "tlr",
                                               "tmb_braf", "OSwk", "Death",
                                               "PFSwk", "Progression")]), ]

cat("Patients with complete data:", nrow(data_complete), "\n")
cat("Treatment arms:", paste(levels(data_complete$Rx), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r build-table, include=FALSE}
# Prepare variables for tableone
table_data <- data_complete %>%
  mutate(
    `Treatment Arm` = Rx,
    `Age (years)` = Age,
    Sex = ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(sex)) == 1, "Male", "Female"),
    `CRP-positive (<5 mg/L)` = ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(crp)) == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    `TLR-positive (>=10%)` = ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(tlr)) == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    `TMB/BRAF-positive` = ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(tmb_braf)) == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    `OS (weeks)` = OSwk,
    `Death event` = factor(Death, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    `PFS (weeks)` = PFSwk,
    `Progression event` = factor(Progression, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

vars <- c("Age (years)", "Sex",
          "CRP-positive (<5 mg/L)", "TLR-positive (>=10%)", "TMB/BRAF-positive",
          "OS (weeks)", "Death event", "PFS (weeks)", "Progression event")

cat_vars <- c("Sex", "CRP-positive (<5 mg/L)", "TLR-positive (>=10%)",
              "TMB/BRAF-positive", "Death event", "Progression event")

tab1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = vars,
  strata = "Treatment Arm",
  data = table_data,
  factorVars = cat_vars,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

tab1_df <- print(tab1, showAllLevels = TRUE, quote = FALSE,
                 noSpaces = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(tab1_df,
      caption = "Table S1: Baseline patient characteristics by treatment arm",
      format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Data from METIMMOX trial (NCT03388190). n=65 patients with complete biomarker data.",
      "CRP = C-reactive protein; TLR = target lesion reduction; TMB = tumor mutational burden.",
      "Biomarker definitions: CRP-positive (CRP <5.0 mg/L at week 4, before the first nivolumab dose); TLR-positive (>=10% reduction at first assessment); TMB/BRAF-positive (TMB >=9 mut/Mb or BRAF V600E)."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

write.csv(tab1_df, file = here("tables", "table_s1.csv"))
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_s1.csv"), "\n")
```

Table S1 has been saved to `tables/table_s1.csv`.
